notes.title: More quality of life/balance changes to Clawdina
notes.content:
[b]Less attacks required for each phase of Clawdina
[/b]
Phase 1: Reduced attacks needed till signature to 2 from 4
Phase 2: Reduced attacks needed till signature to 3 from 4
Phase 3: Reduced attacks needed till signature to 6 from 7

Clawdina won't repeat the same attack in a row anymore

Added slightly more time between attacks in phase 3

Whack attack has less chance to spawn an addition claw

[b]Overall the boss should still be a big challenge but more fair to learn and less of a slog once you learn phase 1 and 2[/b]

Phase 2: Reduced attacks needed till signature to 3 from 4
Phase 3: Reduced attacks needed till signature to 6 from 7

Added slightly more time between attacks in phase 3
Whack attack has less chance to spawn an addition claw

notes.title: First Big Demo Update v0.3
notes.content:
Yoyo! A new update is out for the demo build, cleaning up the house and fixing some much needed things

[list]
[*]The sound menu now functions properly, saving your sound and setting it once you reopen the game
[*]Player rotation is saved and resets on restart
[*]Lots of places to get stuck are now adjusted
[*]Velocity is reset on restart so you don't go flying if you were falling before restarting
[*]You can jump when really close to objects now, without your jump height being drastically reduced!
[*]Moved grub out of glass jar
[*]Categorized uncategorized sound effects
[/list]
